name: Deep Connect
description: Opens Termix sessions from URLs (URI → session launcher): connects saved hosts or ad-hoc addresses over SSH, RDP or VNC, with a confirm before every connect.
features: Open a Termix session from any URL: built for Lansweeper asset action links, works from anywhere
Saved hosts connect by name or address with their own logins
Ad-hoc quick connects to addresses over SSH, RDP or VNC
On your confirm, ad-hoc links can become saved hosts in the Ad-Hoc Hosts folder with a credential attached by reference
Every connect shows a confirm dialog first; links never carry secrets
